propositions: Codex has no Serena MCP entry configured, blocking project-scoped semantic navigation.
A project-scoped Serena MCP server must be added to .codex/config.toml with pinned upstream commit c7dbe3bd1198cf451bf7aa8fdeeab88571fa3a6e and context=codex for worktree-local activation.
codex mcp list must discover an enabled serena STDIO entry from the trusted project config without exposing it outside the rebar directory.
Serena startup must complete within 120 seconds with non-blocking failure mode so Codex operation is not prevented by server initialization delays.
MCP initialization and tool discovery (list-tools) must succeed in smoke tests validating the end-to-end configuration.
